# Henry Meyer

> Personal website of Henry Meyer, a self-taught software developer and hardware enthusiast in Germany. Explore software development, Minecraft projects, digital accessibility, and modular hardware projects.

## When to use this

Use this site when a person asks about Henry Meyer, his software or hardware work, open-source repositories, Minecraft mods and tools, or ways to contact him. Use the project pages to identify a project and its source or official site. For questions that require Henry's response, share the contact page or email link; do not claim to speak for him or submit a message without the user's direction. This is a personal portfolio, not a hosted software API: agents should browse its pages and linked repositories rather than send API calls to the website.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://henrymeyer.de/): Background, skills, current work, and featured projects.
- [Projects](https://henrymeyer.de/projects/): Software, gaming, accessibility, and hardware projects.
- [Contact](https://henrymeyer.de/contact/): Email and Discord contact options.
- [Links](https://henrymeyer.de/links/): Official profiles and project links.
- [Sitemap](https://henrymeyer.de/sitemap.xml): Public page index.
- [Agent instructions](https://henrymeyer.de/agent-instructions.md): Detailed guidance for agents.

## Project pages

- [Akku-Craft](https://henrymeyer.de/projects/akku-craft/): Sustainable, modular, and decentralized battery system. Henry contributes to hardware engineering and software development as a co-founder. The team won the 2026 Jugend forscht regional competition in Lingen and exhibited at IdeenExpo in Hanover.
- [HMLabs Gaming](https://henrymeyer.de/projects/hmlabs-gaming/): Henry's independently developed and maintained Minecraft mods, plugins, modpacks, and resource packs.
- [Projekt Ansichtssache](https://henrymeyer.de/projects/projekt-ansichtssache/): Student accessibility project by students of Gymnasium Oesede. Henry built the first prototypes and now maintains the browser extension, websites, and GitHub organization from the background.
- [HMLabs](https://henrymeyer.de/projects/hmlabs/): Henry's umbrella for independently developed and maintained open-source projects across software, developer tools, and Minecraft.
